title: Correct n0, a, b
description: Essential: Student correctly states n0=0, a = sqrt(Z_ext/r), and b = sqrt(r Z_ext).

title: Correct equilibrium density
description: Essential: Student correctly finds the total electron density as n_e = sqrt((Z_ext1 + Z_ext2)/r) and provides the numerical value 20e10 cm^{-3}.

title: Current expression derivation
description: Important: Student derives the full current I in terms of U, β, L, S, Z_ext, r, e, using the balance of generation and recombination.

title: Low-voltage resistivity
description: Important: Student correctly finds the resistivity ρ_gas = (1/(2eβ)) * sqrt(r/Z_ext) from the low-voltage current approximation.

title: Differential equation setup
description: Important: Student correctly writes the differential equations dI_e/dx = e Z_ext S + α I_e and -dI_i/dx = e Z_ext S + α I_e for the self-sustained discharge.

title: Boundary conditions application
description: Important: Student correctly applies the boundary conditions I_i(L)=0 and I_e(0)=γ I_i(0) to solve for constants.

title: Total current with emission
description: Important: Student derives the total current I = (e Z_ext S/α) * (e^{αL}/(1 - γ + γ e^{αL}) - 1).

title: Critical length expression
description: Essential: Student correctly finds L_cr = (1/α) ln(1 + 1/γ).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student makes a sign error in the ion current differential equation (-dI_i/dx) or misapplies the current direction.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student demonstrates dimensional analysis or unit consistency in final expressions (e.g., for I, ρ, L_cr).
